I mean, you got our number...' is actually at ~06:34, not 05:38, and the customer line 'I'm definitely can't, like, think about solar until I get a new roof' is at ~06:19-06:34, not 05:38. Fix both timestamps to reflect their actual location in the transcript; 05:38 itself is where the customer first mentions being 'scheduled to get a new roof with a fifty year warranty,' which is a distinct, earlier moment already correctly cited elsewhere (cherry_pick_moments, coaching_focus). Core trajectory read, rep-intent framing, and outcome classification (no_appointment) are all well-supported and should be retained.
